annotations.description: The collector reports the PROD Hosting origin Down on a fresh sample for 4 minutes. Stale or Unknown telemetry does not page. Inspect Now 1 row Hosting.
A fresh collector GET of the PROD Cloud Run /health returned non-200 for 4 minutes. A missing origins file reports Unknown and does not page. Inspect Now 1 rows Reader and Command and PWA & APIs.

Reader plus command PROD request_count with response_code_class 5xx summed over the last 10 minutes is at or above 5. Idle (no requests) is normal and does not page. Inspect PWA & APIs request and error charts.
annotations.summary: PROD reader and command returned 5 or more 5xx responses in 10 minutes

annotations.description: Cloud Scheduler job mw-credit-app-prod-notifications finished 3 or more attempts with a non-OK status in 10 minutes. Inspect Now 1 row Notify worker and PWA & APIs Cloud Scheduler attempts. Never force a live notification.
annotations.summary: Notification dispatch scheduler failed 3 or more attempts in 10 minutes

annotations.description: The newest completed daily-charges run is older than 25 h or the newest completed recent-analytics run is older than 75 min (pwa_job_runs via the collector; state 2 = overdue). Stale telemetry does not page. Inspect Now 7 and the PWA & APIs scheduler row.

The oldest pending or retry push delivery is older than 15 minutes. Failed deliveries in 24 hours are shown on Now 6 but do not page (expired subscriptions are normal churn). Reconcile an uncertain send before any retry; never force a live notification.
A fresh collector probe of the recognizer /healthz failed for 4 minutes. Paused (enabled false) and stale telemetry do not page. Inspect Now 1 row Receipt recognizer and Agent & Receipts.

A Partner turn running for over 15 minutes, a finished turn whose reply notice is still unreserved after 5 minutes, a poll older than 10 minutes, or the wake path inactive, for 10 minutes. The 10-minute pending period covers a long turn briefly counted as undelivered until its notice is reserved. Stale telemetry does not page. Inspect Now 5 and Agent & Receipts.
annotations.summary: Partner conversation stalled: turn stuck, reply undelivered or polling stopped
